content: {"like":["Video quality is demo‑worthy with spot‑on color resolution, superb contrast, deep blacks, fine grain adding depth, and no noticeable artifacts.","Audio quality is top‑notch with DTS‑HD Master Audio 7.1, immersive soundtrack, balanced dialogue and effects, and excellent bass performance.","Extras are interesting, including a table reading with cast, a documentary on the BB‑8 robot, a documentary on John Williams’ score, creature creation, and some deleted scenes."]}
